verdict.rationale: Oyster documents a public API with client-credentials auth, developer sandboxes with seed data, and endpoint-level guides for creating and submitting EOR employments, benefits, and engagements. It also publishes an llms.txt index of the public API docs, which suits AI-native consumers. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: From syncing data between applications to fully embedding global hiring capabilities in your application, our API can help you unlock the value of global employment.
